description:
Make the `scripts/docs-check-selftest.sh` self-test pass as the registered gate `docs-check-selftest` over the script it tests.

## Background

`scripts/docs-check-selftest.sh` is a re-runnable self-test of the documentation mechanical checkers (`scripts/docs-check-*.sh`) and their orchestrator `scripts/docs-mechanical.sh`, seeding each checker's defect class and asserting it fails, then asserting it passes once the seed is reverted. It exits 2 when `jit` or `jq` is missing. Until planning, no gate ran it. The gate `docs-check-selftest` was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning, so this task and the container can require it; this task makes it pass and keeps its inputs complete. The `docs-mechanical` gate runs the checkers over the tree, not their self-test. The registered gate's inputs omit files the self-test and its checkers read: the checker configurations `scripts/docs-policy-phrases.toml` (read at `docs-check-selftest.sh:607`), `scripts/docs-canonical-homes.toml` and `scripts/docs-package-content.toml`; the repository files the clone-based projection and policy assertions read, `docs/reference/configuration.md`, `docs/guide.md` and the projection targets such as `.jit/reference/rules-and-gates.md`; and `scripts/generate-shipped-policy-regions.sh` and `profiles/jit-fixture`, which the checkers invoke or read.

The self-test prints `SKIP` and continues to a passing exit when the read bit is not enforced, as for root: `:197` skips the nested-traversal assertions and `:201` skips the unreadable-path assertions, so on such a host the checkers' environment-error exits go unproven.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `docs-check-selftest` runs `scripts/docs-check-selftest.sh`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `docs-check-selftest` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
- [hard] REQ-03: The unreadable-path and nested-traversal assertions run on every host. Where the read bit is not enforced, the self-test either establishes an unreadable input another way or exits non-zero naming the precondition it could not establish. No branch prints a skip notice and continues to a passing exit.
title: Documentation checker self-test runs as a declared gate
